svg.title: MOKS runtime investigation flow
svg.desc: A person asks a question and the worker re-checks their access. Triage and log reading run first, then skills are selected by rules and their read-only steps run, which can include kb_search. With a model, a bounded plan and act loop requests more tools, and skill bodies join the prompts as trusted text. Without a model, or after a model failure, rule-based follow-ups run. Every tool call passes the ToolExecutor, and results come back as evidence that is fenced as untrusted data in prompts. Correlation follows, then a model report or rule-based report. Code then validates citations and marks only deterministic detector findings as verified. Proposed actions are suggestions, and only the separate executor can change anything, after plan review.
